sentence: Effect of Psychiatric Advance Directives Facilitated by Peer Workers on Compulsory Admission Among People With Mental Illness
label: none

sentence: Do psychiatric advance directives facilitated by peer workers (PW-PAD) reduce coercion and improve clinical outcomes among people with schizophrenia, bipolar I disorder, or schizoaffective disorder?
label: none

sentence: In this randomized clinical trial, 394 adults with schizophrenia, bipolar I disorder, or schizoaffective disorder with a previous compulsory hospitalization were randomized into 2 groups (ratio 1:1).
label: none

sentence: Participants in the PW-PAD group experienced significantly fewer compulsory admissions than those in the control group.
label: none

sentence: These findings support the use of peer worker–facilitated psychiatric advance directives to prevent compulsory rehospitalization in people with severe mental illness.
label: none

sentence: Reducing the use of coercion in mental health care is crucial from a human rights and public health perspective.
label: none

sentence: Psychiatric advance directives (PADs) are promising tools that may reduce compulsory admissions.
label: none

sentence: Assessments of PADs have included facilitation by health care agents but not facilitation by peer workers.
label: none

sentence: To determine the efficacy of PADs facilitated by peer workers (PW-PAD) in people with mental disorders.
label: none

sentence: Design, Setting, and Participants
label: none

sentence: A multicenter randomized clinical trial was conducted in 7 French mental health facilities.
label: none

sentence: Adults with a DSM-5 diagnosis of schizophrenia, bipolar I disorder, or schizoaffective disorder who had a compulsory admission in the past 12 months and the capacity to consent were enrolled between January 2019 and June 2020 and followed up for 12 months.
label: none

sentence: The PW-PAD group was invited to fill out a PAD form and meet a peer worker who was trained to assist in completing and sharing the form with relatives and psychiatrists.
label: none

sentence: Main Outcomes and Measures
label: none

sentence: The primary outcome was the rate of compulsory admission at 12 months after randomization.
label: none

sentence: The overall psychiatric admission rate, therapeutic alliance, quality of life, mental health symptoms, empowerment, and recovery outcomes were also investigated.
label: none

sentence: Among 394 allocated participants (median age, 39 years; 39.3% female; 45% with schizophrenia, 36% bipolar I disorder, and 19% schizoaffective disorder), 196 were assigned to the PW-PAD group and 198 to the control group.
label: none

sentence: In the PW-PAD group, 27.0% had compulsory admissions compared with 39.9% in the control group (risk difference, −0.13; 95% CI, −0.22 to −0.04; P = .007).
label: none

sentence: No significant differences were found in the rate of overall admissions, therapeutic alliance score, and quality of life.
label: none

sentence: Participants in the PW-PAD group exhibited fewer symptoms (effect size, −0.20; 95% CI, −0.40 to 0.00), greater empowerment (effect size, 0.30; 95% CI, 0.10 to 0.50), and a higher recovery score (effect size, 0.44; 95% CI, 0.24 to 0.65), compared with those in the control group.
label: none

sentence: Conclusions and Relevance
label: none

sentence: Peer worker–facilitated PADs are effective in decreasing compulsory hospital admissions and increasing some mental health outcomes (self-perceived symptoms, empowerment, and recovery).
label: none

sentence: Involving peer workers in the completion of PADs supports the current shift of mental health care from substitute decision-making to supported decision-making.
label: none

sentence: Respect for patient autonomy is such a strong pillar of health care that involuntary treatment should be unusual.
label: none

sentence: Despite this ethical and clinical principle, compulsory psychiatric admissions are far too common in countries of all income levels.1,2,3
label: none

sentence: In the last 20 years, several randomized clinical trials (RCTs) have assessed the effectiveness of interventions in reducing compulsory psychiatric admissions, and systematic reviews showed that the most effective were psychiatric advance statements.4 Psychiatric advance statements are written documents that allow adults who have mental illness to state their will and preferences in advance so their choices can be applied if further mental health crises impair their decision-making capacity.
label: none

sentence: A meta-analysis of the 5 most robust RCTs on this topic was published in 2019.5 Molyneaux et al5 suggested that (1) psychiatric advance statements reduced the risk of compulsory admission among individuals with mental disorders by 25% compared with usual care; (2) RCTs did not provide firm conclusions on other criteria such as therapeutic alliance or psychiatric outcomes; and (3) similar and higher effectiveness was found in pooled studies that addressed interventions with crisis planning and facilitation by health care professionals.
label: none

sentence: Other research highlights the importance of facilitation in completing psychiatric advance statements,6 but having health care professionals serve as facilitators is not an obvious choice.
label: none

sentence: Indeed, a climate of coercion in psychiatry has been described, with informal coercion and use of power beyond formal coercion, that is, involuntary admissions and compulsory treatment.7,8 The relationship between patients and health care professionals is permeated by this coercive climate more than clinicians realize.9 Because autonomy and self-determination are the main tenets of psychiatric advance statements,10 this system can be improved if facilitation is provided by other types of professionals who are less likely to exert undue influence.
label: none

sentence: To date, RCTs have assessed facilitation by researchers11 and patient advocates,12 but their results are not as significant as those where health care professionals were the facilitators.
label: none

sentence: In France, advance directives were created by law in 2005 and primarily used in end-of-life health care.
label: none

sentence: Psychiatric advance directives (PADs) have been used without a formal legal or practical framework.
label: none

sentence: We hypothesized that PADs could be implemented with facilitation by peer workers, ie, people with personal experiences of mental distress and psychiatric services who are employed and trained to support others.13 Interest in the facilitation of PADs by peer workers is increasing, and a comparison between peer workers and health care agents found no differences in PAD completion rate and quality.14 Recent studies showed that PADs facilitated by peer workers were more prescriptive than those facilitated by nonpeer clinicians and had high feasibility and consistency as rated by experts.15
label: none

sentence: To our knowledge, no study has been conducted of the effect on clinical outcomes of peer worker–facilitated PADs (PW-PADs).
label: none

sentence: The current study addresses this evidence gap to determine whether PW-PADs for people with severe mental illness reduce compulsory admissions and provide significant benefits in terms of therapeutic alliance, quality of life, mental illness symptoms, empowerment, and recovery.
label: none
